Name: Large Void Egg
Author: strobel1ght
Description:
Void Chickens are great but they don't produce a deluxe product similar to the regular chickens. This is why I decided to add the Large Void Egg to the game.

[img]data:image/png;base64,[/img]
[size=4]
[/size][b][size=4][u]Important:[/u][/size][/b]
- This mod will be applied for Void Chickens that hatch after this mod is installed.
- This cannot be added to the Mayonnaise Machine at the moment and that is why the base sell price is 275.

Base selling price: 275g
Silver-quality: 343g
Gold-quality: 412g
Iridium-quality: 550g

[b][u][size=4]Requirements:[/size][/u][/b]
1) Latest [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url]
2) Latest [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
3) Latest [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]

[b][u][size=4]Installation:[/size][/u][/b]
1) Download both main files [color=#ff0000][color=#ffffff][b]Large Void Egg (Json Assets)[/b][/color] [/color]and [b]Large Void Egg (Content Patcher)[/b]
2) Unzip both and place them in your SDV/Mods folder

[img]data:image/png;base64,[/img]

You should have these two folders in your Mods folder along with the required mods (JA, CP, SMAPI)
